---
title: "Data: mobility, ecology and epidemics"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("tfl-cycle-hire-2026-02", "opensky-covid-flightlist-2020-04", "alien-species-first-records-rem", "alien-first-records-v4", "covid-bucharest-transmission")
```

Movements between places (bike stations, airports), species reaching new regions, and transmission between people. Bike and flight data have strong daily cycles and suit global covariates such as weather; invasion records are one-shot species-to-region events for `risk = "remove"`; transmission chains are trees.

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
